s0.speaker: narrator
s0.text: The great moth folded its wings. One lantern slipped from its silk and rolled across the stones. The flame did not go out. It rose, and fled into the dark - toward a temple between pages.

s2.speaker: lamplighter
s2.text_low_hope: ...Don't let him... put you out too...

s3.speaker: narrator
s3.text: His flame curls around your hand and stays.  (POWER: LANTERN FLARE - press Q)
